note: The hosts the 2026-08-16 CUDA campaign actually ran, as data. Two RunPod
secure-cloud RTX A4000 pods (sm_86, $0.25/hr each), same GPU type on purpose
so no row confounds an OS axis with a CUDA-architecture change. Endpoints
were ssh host:port pairs assigned by RunPod at boot; pods are gone.
The pair holds torch at 2.13.0+cu126 on BOTH sides. That wheel choice is
itself a measured constraint: 2.13.0+cu130 initialised on pod A
(driver 580.126, CUDA 13) and REFUSED on pod B (driver 12080-class),
so the one wheel that runs on both fleets' drivers is the cu126 build.
Pod A additionally ran the same-host arm twice, once per wheel
(+cu130 and +cu126), and the anchor captures for the wrapper-transform
